chunks: Take my shirt and put it on my father's face; his eyesight will be restored; and bring your entire family to me.
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph tell his brothers to do with his shirt to restore Jacob's sight?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) utilizes his shirt as a tangible instrument of divine healing (shifa), a motif often highlighted in Shia exegesis as a precursor to the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt. The command to bring the entire family underscores the restoration of the patriarchal lineage and the fulfillment of the divine promise made to Jacob, marking the transition from separation to unity.
